description_en: Creates a consumer group (ConsumerGroup) for ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ. A consumer group is a load balancing group in ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ that contains multiple consumers with consistent consumption behavior. Consumers must subscribe to related topics by specifying a consumer group to implement message subscription
description_zh: 创建云消息队列 RocketMQ 版的消费者分组（ConsumerGroup）。消费者分组是云消息队列 RocketMQ 版系统中承载多个消费行为一致的消费者的负载均衡分组。消费者需要通过指定消费者分组订阅相关的主题来实现消息订阅
kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq create-consumer-group --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --consumer-group-id GID_test_groupId --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to which the consumer group to be created belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待创建的消费者分组所属的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the consumer group to be created. Used as the identity of the consumer group, which is globally unique.

Valid values:

Character restrictions: letters a~z or A~Z, digits 0~9, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
Length restrictions: 1 to 60 characters.

For reserved word restrictions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.help_zh:
待创建的消费者分组的ID。用于标识消费者分组，全局唯一。

取值说明如下：

字符限制：支持字母a\~z或A\~Z、数字0\~9以及下划线（_）、短划线（-）。
长度限制：1~60个字符。

保留字符限制，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440347.html
parameters.name: consumer_group_id

fields.help_en:
The dead-letter topic.

If a consumer fails to consume a message and the message still failed after retries, the message is delivered to the dead-letter topic for subsequent business recovery or backtracking. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
fields.help_zh:
死信Topic。

消费者出现异常消费某条消息失败，且消息重试后依然未成功，消息将被投递至死信Topic中，以便后续进行业务恢复或回溯。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
fields.name: dead_letter_target_topic

fields.help_en:
The fixed retry interval, in seconds. This parameter takes effect when the retry policy is set to FixedRetryPolicy.

Valid values:
Concurrent delivery: 10 to 1800
Ordered delivery: 1 to 600
fields.help_zh:
固定重试间隔，单位：秒。重试策略为FixedRetryPolicy固定间隔重试策略时生效
取值范围：
并发投递：10-1800
顺序投递：1-600
fields.name: fixed_interval_retry_time

fields.help_en: The maximum number of retry attempts
fields.name: max_retry_times

fields.help_en:
The retry policy type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html.

Valid parameter values:
FixedRetryPolicy: fixed-interval retry, supported only for ordered delivery
DefaultRetryPolicy: progressive backoff retry, supported only for concurrent delivery
fields.help_zh:
重试策略类型。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html。

参数取值如下：
FixedRetryPolicy：固定间隔重试，仅支持顺序投递
DefaultRetryPolicy：阶梯退避重试，仅支持并发投递
fields.name: retry_policy

parameters.help_en: The consumption retry policy of the consumer group to be created. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
parameters.help_zh:
待创建消费者分组的消费重试策略。更多信息，请参见
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440356.html
parameters.name: consume_retry_policy

parameters.help_en:
The delivery order type of the consumer group to be created.

Valid parameter values:
Concurrently: concurrent delivery
Orderly: ordered delivery
parameters.help_zh:
待创建消费者分组的投递顺序性。

参数取值如下：
Concurrently：并发投递
Orderly：顺序投递
parameters.name: delivery_order_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable exclusive subscription, which means a LiteTopic can only be subscribed to by one consumer. Set to true to enable or false to shutdown
parameters.help_zh: 排他订阅，表示一个LiteTopic只能被一个消费者订阅。true 表示开启，false 表示关闭
parameters.name: exclusive

parameters.help_en: The maximum TPS for consuming messages
parameters.name: max_receive_tps

parameters.help_en:
The subscribe pattern for consumers:
CLUSTERING: clustering consumption pattern. All consumers in the ConsumerGroup share the same subscription.
LITE_SELECTIVE: lightweight consumption pattern. Consumers in the ConsumerGroup can have different subscriptions
parameters.help_zh:
消费者对消息的消费模式：
CLUSTERING：集群消费模式，ConsumerGroup下每个消费者的订阅关系一致。
LITE_SELECTIVE：轻量消费模式，ConsumerGroup下每个消费者的订阅关系可以不一致
parameters.name: message_model

parameters.example: This is the remark for test.
parameters.help_en: The remarks for the consumer group to be created
parameters.help_zh: 待创建消费者分组的备注信息
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the lite-type topic to subscribe to when using the LITE_SELECTIVE consumption pattern
parameters.help_zh: LITE_SELECTIVE 消费模式时，需要订阅的lite类型的topic名称
parameters.name: topic_name

requestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID that is active and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the execute operation was successful
